concoct.definition:
v. make a concoction (of) by mixing
v. prepare or cook by mixing ingredients

concolor.definition: a. Of the same color; of uniform color.

concolors.definition:
plural of concolor
a. Of the same color; of uniform color.

concomitance.definition: n. occurrence or existence together or in connection with one another
concomitance.translation: n. 相伴, 伴随, 共存

concomitancy.definition:
n. The state of accompanying; accompaniment.
n. The doctrine of the existence of the entire body of
   Christ in the eucharist, under each element, so that the body and blood
   are both received by communicating in one kind only.

concomitant.definition:
n an event or situation that happens at the same time as or in connection with another
s following or accompanying as a consequence

a. 相伴的, 伴随的, 共存的
n. 伴随物

concomitantly.definition: adv. In company with others; unitedly; concurrently.

concomitants.definition: n. an event or situation that happens at the same time as or in connection with another
concomitants.translation: n. 伴随发生的事( concomitant的复数形式 ); 伴随物; 共存
